title: Origin story: Krakenborn
description: Krakenborn was born on a ship the kraken took, and raised in the deep — the kraken, sated, left the child in a whale's care. She grew strong in the crushing dark, learned the pressure-tongue, and now she is the deep's ambassador: she rises when the surface world threatens the abyss, and negotiates with tentacles.

title: Ability profile: Krakenborn
description: Ranked abilities: Deep survival — rank 100/100; Pressure strength — rank 99/100; Swimming — rank 98/100; Tentacle command — rank 97/100; Diplomacy — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Krakenborn
description: Powers: The kraken answers her call; Pressure is her element; The deep lends her its strength.

title: Stamina feats: Krakenborn
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Grew up in the crushing dark; Rose from the abyss repeatedly.

title: Crossover notes: Krakenborn
description: Krakenborn crosses naturally with: the abyss, tentacles, the crushing deep.
